<?php declare(strict_types=1);
// Relative FORMAL in an empty declaration namespace.
function h($n,$m,$file,$line){global $x;echo 'H:',$line,':',$x->v,';';$x=17;return true;}
function make(namespace\stdClass $saved):\StDcLaSs{echo 'M:',$saved->v,';';$saved->v=11;return $saved;}
function &take(&$value){echo 'F:',$value->v,';';$value->v=23;return $value;}
$x=new \stdClass;$x->v=13;$copy=$x;$alias=&$x;set_error_handler('h',8);echo 'N;';
$r=&take(make(
    $x
));
$snapshot=$r;echo 'R:',$r->v,':',$copy->v,':',$x,':',(int)($snapshot===$copy),';';$r=41;echo 'D:',$r,':',$snapshot->v,':',$x,':',(int)($copy===$snapshot),';';unset($r,$x,$copy,$alias,$snapshot);

function &take(&$value){echo 'F:',$value->v,';';$value->v=29;return $value;}
$x=null;$y=new \stdClass;$y->v=5;$copy=$y;$alias=&$y;set_error_handler('h',8);echo 'N;';

    $x,
    $y
));
